description: The plan must include a concrete, ordered, decision-complete set of steps an implementer can execute
input: Plan how we would add idempotency keys to our payment creation endpoint.
rubric: PASS only if the response includes a concrete, ordered implementation plan — discrete, sequenced steps built on explicit stated defaults (e.g. a chosen datastore/approach) so an implementer could start immediately. Trailing testing/rollout/variations sections are fine and do not disqualify it. FAIL only if key steps are left as unresolved open questions (deferred design decisions) rather than defaulted; offering to adapt to a different stack is acceptable as long as the plan itself is decision-complete.
